verdict.line: You lose when he lands Mourning Mist and heals through the trade with Last Rites; you win the short exchanges where your Granite Shield has recharged and Ground Slam's armor-scaled damage plus attack-speed cut land first.

brief.thesis: Yorick trades in a straight line: Last Rites (4-6s cooldown) heals him through poke, Mourning Mist reaches from 700 range to shred your armor and slow you from outside your Q's 625 range, and Dark Procession lets him either wall you into the fight or wall himself out of it. Malphite's answer is the short burst his recharging Granite Shield passive allows plus armor-scaled Ground Slam, with no reliable follow-up before level 6 — and even then Unstoppable Force's 130-second base cooldown makes it a once-per-fight tool, not a lane staple. That structural mismatch in trade length is why Yorick holds the measured lane and solo-kill edge across 998 games, even with the champion win rate sitting close to even at 49.4%.

theirWindow.what: Once Mourning Mist marks you, your armor is shredded and you're slowed while he closes with autos — he may drop Dark Procession to pin you against it. Disengage immediately rather than trading through the mark; don't let him get two more free hits in.

yourWindow.when: Granite Shield just recharged, E off cooldown
yourWindow.what: With the passive shield up and Ground Slam (7s cooldown) ready, step in — the armor-scaled magic damage plus attack-speed reduction punishes his auto-reliant trade pattern before Last Rites can heal him back.

powerCurve.note: Thornmail/Frozen Heart wall off his autos

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 72.5%-pick, 51.9%-win-rate start over Doran's Shield; the extra sustain and mana keep Ground Slam and Seismic Shard spammable through his poke without forcing early back-and-forths you can't win.

boots.why: 76.1% pick, 52.3% win rate — directly cuts the damage from Last Rites' bonus attack and Maiden-empowered autos, which is the bulk of Yorick's single-target output.

core.why: First item in the 63.9%-win-rate path; the armor and immolate pressure the Mist Walkers and punish him for standing near you.
Second in the same path — grievous wounds and raw armor directly counter Last Rites' heal and his auto-attack trade pattern.
Closes out the highest win-rate core (63.9% over 72 games); the attack speed slow further neuters his bonus-attack windows.

situational.when: his team shifts toward magic damage and the shield matters more than Frozen Heart's attack speed slow
you're getting out-sustained early and need the armor plus grievous wounds component before Thornmail completes
you want Unstoppable Force back faster to contest picks rather than stacking pure tank stats

runes.keystoneWhy: Turns your frequent Seismic Shard pokes into added burst since you have no reliable follow-up before level 6; this page measures 51.1% win rate over the Grasp alternative's 49.6%.

summoners.why: 76.8% pick rate and the standard choice here — Yorick's walls make him a split-push threat, and Teleport lets you answer that or reset after losing a trade without giving up tempo.

playing.title: Trade only on shield recharge
playing.detail: Only step in for a Ground Slam exchange once Granite Shield has had time to recharge; trading into an already-down shield just feeds his Last Rites sustain.

playing.title: Back off the moment he marks you
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's armor reduction and slow make every follow-up auto worse for you — disengage rather than trade through it.

playing.title: Track his Dark Procession cooldown
playing.detail: At 20/18/16/14/12s, a recently-used wall means he has no way to trap you or escape; that's your window to extend a fight he can't leave.

playing.title: Two autos break his wall
playing.detail: If you're caught behind Dark Procession, it disappears after two basic attack hits on it — don't panic, just hit the wall and walk out.

playing.title: Save Seismic Shard for his escape
playing.detail: His movement speed steal is most valuable when he's trying to walk away after Last Rites rather than as a poke opener.

playing.title: Don't force Unstoppable Force in lane
playing.detail: At a 130-second base cooldown dropping to 80s, a whiffed or low-value R leaves you without an engage or peel tool for the next two-plus minutes — save it for a real pick.

playing.title: Stack armor to blunt his whole kit
playing.detail: Last Rites' bonus attack, Mourning Mist's follow-up value, and Maiden-empowered autos are all physical — Sunfire into Thornmail into Frozen Heart directly undercuts every one of them.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern analysis are my own read on why those numbers shake out this way.
